acceptance.contract: Design quality judged from rendered screenshots. No modulo/hash tinting, no repeated rail pseudo-elements, no gradient-with-label illustrations. Chapter art must never obscure prose. No text inside SVG art (chainage lives in figcaption).
acceptance.integration: body[data-book="the-fountainhead"][data-part-id="part-1"] + body[data-chapter] + body[data-art="keating-pilasters"]; reader.js inlines symbol per entry into #chapter-art.banner
acceptance.schema: READER-CONTRACT v1.1 §4 + A.2 symbol key; ART-DIRECTION.md §11; supervisor merges chapters{} into design/chapters.json sequentially

p1c1.caption: STA K-I · 5,736 words · FIG CLIFF
p1c1.contentRationale: Roark's origin: the cliff he dives from on expulsion morning, the orange-rind hair, the Dean's defeat. The coolest opener in the book (0%) — all granite, one ember line for the dive arc.
notes: FIG CLIFF retained (CHAPTERS.md): opening line 'He stood naked at the edge of a cliff.' (p1c1 para 0, verified substring).
Bars STRATA (CHAPTERS.md why stands): rock layers of the cliff.
Verification needle: 'edge of a cliff' — 'cliff' occurs 2× in p1c1.
p1c1.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c1 (FIG CLIFF study: 3 Ash strata slabs over the waterline, Ember dive-arc; pilaster border pristine; T-square true) + Bronze Plex chainage stamp + Oswald meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c1.title: Chapter I

p1c10.caption: STA K-X · 6,679 words · FIG CHECK
p1c10.contentRationale: The chapter's terminus: the $500 check that charters Roark's practice. HIGHBARS carry both halves (salon cornices above, cliff ledges below); the FIG study is the check — the warmest object in Part 1, hence the highest non-climax fill (15%).
notes: FIG CHECK overrides HOLCOMBE (lead-accepted): Holcombe is the opening salon only; the commission is the chapter's weight. Needle: 'The check was made out to "Howard Roark, Architect."' (p1c10 para 198, verified substring).
Bars HIGHBARS (CHAPTERS.md why stands): the eclectic's palace cornices.
No-text-in-art deviation recorded: the '500' amount is a Bronze tick device, not Plex numerals.
Verification needle: 'check' occurs 3× in p1c10.
p1c10.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c10 (FIG CHECK study: Bone slip, Ash written lines, Bronze signature, Bronze amount ticks, Ember salute line; T-square slips 3.5°) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c10.title: Chapter X

p1c11.caption: STA K-XI · 4,375 words · FIG DOOR
p1c11.contentRationale: The glass entrance door with his name — photographed, sent to Cameron, held between them. SINGLE-LO is the office floor line; the FIG study is the door itself, the only 'portrait' in the cohort that is a name on glass (rendered as Bronze rule-lines, never text).
notes: FIG DOOR overrides ATTIC (lead-accepted): 'attic' occurs 0× in p1c11. Needle: 'The glass entrance door bore the words: "Howard Roark, Architect."' (p1c11 para 0, verified substring).
Bars SINGLE-LO (CHAPTERS.md why stands): one top-floor room — the office sill line.
T-square returns to TRUE here (Roark's room; the only true edge after p1c2).
Verification needle: 'door' occurs 4× in p1c11.
p1c11.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c11 (FIG DOOR study right: Ash frame, Bone glass sheen, 3 Bronze name-lines, Ember hinge point; T-square TRUE) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c11.title: Chapter XI

p1c12.caption: STA K-XII · 9,349 words · FIG BANNER
p1c12.contentRationale: The Banner as the chapter's medium: Scarret's front page, Dominique's column, the killed meeting story. HIGHBARS are the headline columns; the FIG study is the folded front page. The shadow and quicksand belong to the prose, not the opener — art never stages Katie's terror as decoration.
notes: FIG BANNER retained (CHAPTERS.md + lead): the chapter's medium throughout. Needle: 'appeared daily on the front page of the New York Banner' (p1c12 para 0, verified substring).
Bars HIGHBARS (CHAPTERS.md why stands): Scarret's headlines.
T-square slips 4° (steepest slip — the surrender chapter).
Verification needle: 'Banner' occurs 5× in p1c12. Longest chapter in Part 1 (9,349 words); no mid-text devices.
p1c12.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c12 (FIG BANNER study: folded paper, Bronze masthead rule, 3 Ash column rules, Ember column edge; headline bars high) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c12.title: Chapter XII

p1c13.caption: STA K-XIII · 6,096 words · FIG STATION
p1c13.contentRationale: The built center of the chapter: Gowan's filling station on the Post Road — glass cylinder, concrete oval, pump colonnade, bubbles. STRATA are the Post Road courses the station rises beside. Hottest non-climax fill (20%) because this is built Roark, finally standing.
notes: FIG STATION overrides HELLER per LEAD RULING (designer proposed HELLER retained with BUBBLES alternate; lead chose STATION): the station is the built center. 'station' occurs 7× in p1c13. Needle: 'filling station of my own' (p1c13 para 2, verified substring).
Bars STRATA RE-AUTHORED (lead-directed): Post Road courses — NOT Heller-house massing. Panel draws glass cylinder + concrete oval + pump colonnade; NO Heller massing anywhere.
Ember @40%: the oval's leading edge.
Verification needle: 'It looked like a cluster of bubbles' (station description, p1c13).
p1c13.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c13 (FIG STATION study: bubbles, glass cylinder, concrete oval, pump colonnade; Post Road strata courses low; T-square slips 4.5°) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c13.title: Chapter XIII

p1c14.caption: STA K-XIV · 5,125 words · FIG ENVELOPE
p1c14.contentRationale: The mailed envelope (the entry, the names) above the deathbed line (Cameron's window). The FIG study is the sealed envelope; SINGLE-LO is both the address line and the still body-line. Cool fill (10%) — this chapter is grief and paper, not heat.
notes: FIG ENVELOPE overrides HEYER (lead-accepted): Heyer opens it; the envelope is its carried object. Needle: 'The envelope, accompanying the entry, contained the names' (p1c14 para 49, verified substring).
Bars SINGLE-LO (CHAPTERS.md why stands): the deathbed line — Cameron's three days.
Authored Ember exception: NO ember anywhere in this panel (Cameron's death cools it).
Verification needle: 'envelope' occurs 1× in p1c14.
p1c14.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c14 (FIG ENVELOPE study resting ON the low deathbed bar: Ash body, Bronze seal-flap, Ash address rules; T-square slips 5°) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c14.title: Chapter XIV

p1c15.caption: STA K-XV · 8,849 words · FIG COMPETITION
p1c15.contentRationale: PART CLIMAX. Fear, blackmail, death, fame, refusal, quarry — the full-width hearth line is earned: Heyer's study lamp, the footlights, the bank boardroom, the train's pinheads all converge in it. Solid Bronze numeral (Keating's metal at its brightest — and its last appearance as a part metal).
notes: FIG COMPETITION retained (CHAPTERS.md + lead): the chapter's spine (fear → Heyer → victory → fame → bank refusal). 'competition' occurs 6× in p1c15. Needle: 'He would lose the competition' (p1c15, verified substring).
Bars HEARTH (climax; CHAPTERS.md): fear, contest, partnership.
Pilaster border GONE — replaced by the hearth line (borrowed orders fully shed). T-square SNAPPED.
Chainage in Emberlight (F1 medium-display license, metered). Part's only full-saturation Ember element.
p1c15.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c15 (FIG COMPETITION study: winner's model on Bronze base over the full-width Ember HEARTH line + single radial hearth glow; SOLID Bronze numeral XV) + Emberlight chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap. First body line visible at 1440×1000 (F4).
p1c15.readingTreatment: Calm body; Bronze ◆ end mark (part-closing; no extra device — finale grammar belongs to p4c20).
p1c15.title: Chapter XV

p1c2.caption: STA K-II · 4,646 words · FIG MEDAL
p1c2.contentRationale: Keating's public coronation (medal + Paris prize) over the private porch surrender. The medal is the chapter's carried object; the porch is its soul — the FIG study shows the medal, the SINGLE-HI bar is Francon's address from the platform.
notes: FIG MEDAL overrides LECTURE (lead-accepted): 'lecture' occurs 0× in p1c2. Needle: 'presented him with a gold medal' (p1c2 para 9, verified substring).

Bars SINGLE-HI RE-AUTHORED (designer must-fix, lead-accepted): Francon's commencement address from the platform — the CHAPTERS.md 'Dean's pronouncement' why was factually wrong (the Dean belongs to p1c1).
T-square true and straight (the last time it is).
Verification needle: 'medal' occurs 2× in p1c2.
p1c2.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c2 (FIG MEDAL study: Bronze disc, Ash ribbon bars, Ember rim glint; single high platform bar) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c2.title: Chapter II

p1c3.caption: STA K-III · 5,939 words · FIG STRINGCOURSE
p1c3.contentRationale: Keating's first-day triumph is one horizontal band of ornament suggested to Francon. The FIG study draws the stringcourse itself — the first 'borrowed line' in the K2 sense (Keating's taste, Stengel's drawing, Francon's signature).
notes: FIG STRINGCOURSE overrides SIDEWALK (lead-accepted): 'sidewalk' occurs 0× in p1c3. Needle: 'an ornamented stringcourse would be so much more appropriate' (p1c3 para 46, verified substring).
Bars STRATA (CHAPTERS.md why stands): city street courses — 'PETER KEATING LOOKED AT THE STREETS OF NEW YORK' (para 0).
T-square slips 1° (authored).
Verification needle: 'stringcourse' occurs 5× in p1c3.
p1c3.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c3 (FIG STRINGCOURSE study: facade fragment, Bronze ornamented band between floors, cartouche blocks; strata street-courses low) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c3.title: Chapter III

p1c4.caption: STA K-IV · 7,407 words · FIG LAMP
p1c4.contentRationale: The lamp is the only object joining the chapter's halves: Keating's green drafting lamp and Cameron's desk lamp. SPLIT bars become the two lamplit desks facing each other across the panel.
notes: FIG LAMP overrides FRANCON (lead-accepted): proper name violates FIG concrete-noun discipline; the lamp links both halves. Needle: 'Bending under a solitary green lamp' (p1c4 para 36, verified substring).
Bars SPLIT RE-AUTHORED (designer should-fix, lead-accepted): two desks after hours — Keating's borrowed night work / Cameron's country-house summons (no salon exists in p1c4).
Palette stays Furnace for the shade (Ash shade, Bronze stem; no green). Pilaster border: one shaft short.
Verification needle: 'lamp' occurs 2× in p1c4.
p1c4.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c4 (FIG LAMP study center over SPLIT bar groups: Ash shade cone, Bronze stem, flat Bone light pool, Ember pool edge) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c4.title: Chapter IV

p1c5.caption: STA K-V · 5,259 words · FIG DRAFTING
p1c5.contentRationale: The drafting-room chapter: Davis's table taken, Stengel's office taken, Roark's hand drawing over Keating's plan. HIGHBARS are the pinned sheets; the FIG study is the tracing-paper overlay moment — K2's thesis image.
notes: FIG DRAFTING retained (CHAPTERS.md + lead): 'drafting' occurs 7×; the drafting room is the main setting. Needle: 'In the drafting room, Keating concentrated on Tim Davis' (p1c5 para 2, verified substring).
Bars HIGHBARS (CHAPTERS.md why stands): sheets pinned up over the boards.
T-square slips 2° (authored). Pilaster border: capital rail gone.
Verification needle: 'drafting' occurs 7× in p1c5.
p1c5.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c5 (FIG DRAFTING study: Ash plan sheet under an angled Bronze overlay sheet with Ember edge; high pinned-sheet bars) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c5.title: Chapter V

p1c6.caption: STA K-VI · 4,399 words · FIG SERMONS
p1c6.contentRationale: The book laid down low across the panel — Toohey's midnight slab — with the heater-fire it answers (Cameron's burning archive) held to a single Ember baseline. The part's hinge: print triumphs, the master exits.
notes: FIG SERMONS retained (CHAPTERS.md + lead): title-word, opening line. Needle: 'SERMONS IN STONE BY ELLSWORTH M. TOOHEY WAS PUBLISHED IN January of the year 1925.' (p1c6 para 0, verified substring).
Bars SINGLE-LO (CHAPTERS.md why stands): one published book, laid down — the bar doubles as the slab's shadow.
Bronze pyramid device per the jacket ('silver pyramid'); Ember @40% on the page-line under-edge.
Verification needle: 'SERMONS' in para 0; 'sermons' occurs 2× in p1c6.
p1c6.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c6 (FIG SERMONS study: deep-Ash book slab low across full width, Bronze pyramid device, thin Bone page line) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c6.title: Chapter VI

p1c7.caption: STA K-VII · 3,191 words · FIG BULLETIN
p1c7.contentRationale: The posted notice high (Cameron's six-line obituary) and the torch below it — death of the master, proof of the heir. The FIG study is the torch jet: the chapter's one true vertical in a part of horizontals.
notes: FIG BULLETIN retained (CHAPTERS.md + lead): opening line. Needle: 'THE BULLETIN OF THE ARCHITECTS’ GUILD OF AMERICA CARRIED' (p1c7 para 0, verified substring).
Bars SINGLE-HI (CHAPTERS.md why stands): the posted Guild notice — strip carries 6 Ash rule-lines (the six misspelled lines).
Torch jet in Furnace metals (Bone flame sliver, Ember root); Ember @40% on the flame root only.
Verification needle: 'BULLETIN' in para 0; 'bulletin' occurs 2× in p1c7.
p1c7.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c7 (notice strip high + FIG BULLETIN/torch study center: angled Ash torch body, Bone jet sliver, Ember root) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c7.title: Chapter VII

p1c8.caption: STA K-VIII · 3,832 words · FIG PHOTOGRAPH
p1c8.contentRationale: The Dana photograph Francon hands Roark — the relic he refuses to betray. STRATA bars become the side-street courses of the closing walk to the East River.
notes: FIG PHOTOGRAPH overrides MUSEUM (lead-accepted, designer-independent challenge): the museum is named in para 0 and never seen; the photograph is causally central. Needle: 'It was a photograph of the Dana Building.' (p1c8 para 7, verified substring).
Bars STRATA RE-AUTHORED (designer should-fix, lead-accepted): street courses of the closing walk (side streets to the East River) — 'museum wall courses' was unsupported.
T-square slips 3° (authored). Pilaster border: three shafts + one stub.
Verification needle: 'photograph' occurs 4× in p1c8.
p1c8.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c8 (FIG PHOTOGRAPH study: tilted Bone-bordered card, Ash granite verticals, Bronze pin, Ember edge tick; strata street-courses low) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c8.title: Chapter VIII

p1c9.caption: STA K-IX · 5,497 words · FIG SKETCHES
p1c9.contentRationale: Snyte's three thuds: the kept pile vs the flipped-aside three. SPLIT bars ARE the two piles; the FIG study is the top sheet of the kept pile with Roark's planes visible under Snyte's added capitals (Ash planes + Bronze appliqué).
notes: FIG SKETCHES retained (CHAPTERS.md + lead): opening line + SPLIT rationale. Needle: 'LOOKED THROUGH ROARK’S SKETCHES, FLIPPED three of them aside, gathered the rest into an even pile' (p1c9 para 0, verified substring).
Bars SPLIT (CHAPTERS.md why stands): kept pile / flipped-aside pile.
T-square slips 3° (authored). Pilaster border: three shafts.
Verification needle: 'SKETCHES' in para 0; 'sketches' occurs 3× in p1c9.
p1c9.openerComposition: FURNACE banner panel #k1-c9 (FIG SKETCHES study: tall kept stack vs three flipped sheets; top sheet with Bronze capital appliqué + Ember correction slash) + chainage + meta + Bronze drop-cap
p1c9.title: Chapter IX
